# Ongig Blog

> A comprehensive resource for recruiting professionals covering job description best practices, AI-powered hiring tools, diversity and inclusion strategies, and talent acquisition insights.

Ongig Blog provides practical guides, tools, and case studies for HR professionals and recruiters looking to improve job descriptions, implement inclusive hiring practices, and leverage AI in recruitment. The blog features expert content on diversity initiatives, employee benefits, and modern recruitment challenges.

## Key Topics

- Job Descriptions
- Talent Acquisition
- Diversity and Inclusion
- AI in Recruitment
- Inclusive Hiring
- Bias Detection
- Job Description Writing
- Diverse Slate Hiring
- DEI Initiatives
- Text Analyzer
- Recruitment Challenges
- Augmented Writing Tools
- Workplace Inclusion
- Employee Benefits
- ChatGPT for HR

## Job Description Guides & Tools

- [How to Write a Job Description — Best Practices & Examples (2026 Update)](https://blog.ongig.com/job-descriptions/how-to-write-a-job-description): Best practices guide for writing job descriptions to attract top talent.
- [The Ultimate List of Job Description Tips](https://blog.ongig.com/job-descriptions/job-description-tips): Comprehensive tips for crafting effective job descriptions and attracting talent.
- [The Best Automated Job Description Builder (2025)](https://blog.ongig.com/job-descriptions/automated-job-description-builder): Guide to Ongig's automated job description builder for efficient JD creation.
- [8 Best Job Description Builder Tools in 2026](https://blog.ongig.com/job-descriptions/job-description-builder-tools): Comparison of 8 job description builder tools including Ongig Text Analyzer.
- [20 Good Job Posting Examples (2017-2026)](https://blog.ongig.com/job-descriptions/good-job-posting-examples): Real-life job posting examples for attracting top talent effectively.
- [Is ChatGPT for Job Descriptions the Right Choice? (2026 Update)](https://blog.ongig.com/job-descriptions/chatgpt-for-job-descriptions): Analysis of using ChatGPT and AI for writing effective job descriptions.

## Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

- [The Diversity & Inclusion Glossary -- A List of 200+ Diversity Terms (2024 Update)](https://blog.ongig.com/diversity-and-inclusion/diversity-terms): Comprehensive 300+ term glossary of DEI language and inclusive terminology.
- [25+ Examples of Awesome Diversity Statements [2024 Update]](https://blog.ongig.com/diversity-and-inclusion/10-examples-of-the-best-diversity-statements): Examples and tips for writing effective diversity statements for companies.
- [9 Best Diversity Tools for Job Descriptions in 2025](https://blog.ongig.com/writing-job-descriptions/diversity-tools): Guide to diversity tools for writing inclusive and bias-free job descriptions.
- [What is "Diverse Slate" Hiring? (2026 Update)](https://blog.ongig.com/diversity-and-inclusion/diverse-slate-hiring): Definition and implementation guide for diverse slate hiring practices.
- [Is Your Company Truly Ready for (Neuro)diversity?](https://blog.ongig.com/diversity-and-inclusion/ready-for-neurodiversity): Guide to supporting neurodivergent talent through hiring and workplace practices.
- [17 Inclusive Employee Benefits to Offer in 2026](https://blog.ongig.com/diversity-and-inclusion/inclusive-employee-benefits): Guide to inclusive employee benefits supporting diverse teams and DEI strategy.
